Package domain

Class PlayerProfile

java.lang.Object
domain.PlayerProfile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerProfile extends Object implements Serializable
Progress of a player: its points, its stats and what it bought in the store.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
